+def _parse_list_item(block: 'BlockParser', bullet: str, groups: Tuple[str,
+    str, str], token: Dict[str, Any], state: 'BlockState', rules: List[str]
+    ) ->Optional[Tuple[str, str, str]]:

+    leading_width = len(listitem_1)
+    pattern = _compile_list_item_pattern(bullet, leading_width)
+    listitem_3 = listitem_3.lstrip()
+    
+    # check if there's a following list item
+    m = re.match(pattern, listitem_3, re.M)
+    if m:
+        # if the first line is a list item, we need to parse it recursively
+        # but first we need to add the current item to the token
+        text, continue_width = _compile_continue_width(listitem_3, leading_width)
+        text = _clean_list_item_text(text, continue_width)
+        if text:
+            state.append_text(text)
+        
+        # now parse the recursive list item
+        return m.groups()
+    
+    # if no more list items, process the current one
+    text, continue_width = _compile_continue_width(listitem_3, leading_width)
+    text = _clean_list_item_text(text, continue_width)
+    
+    # parse the content of the list item
+    if text:
+        # if there's content, parse it with the given rules
+        list_state = state.copy()
+        list_state.set_text(text)
+        list_state.parse_text(rules)
+        children = list_state.tokens
